24: And became defiled - during the period in which she was divorced, since she is only forbidden to return to [her original husband] if she was married [to someone else] by betrothal -- when it says "Then the first husband who divorced her shall not take her [into his household] to become his wife again" [Deuteronomy 24:4], it is referring to after betrothal and marriage, as it says "and becomes [the wife] of another man, then this latter man rejects her" [Deuteronomy 24:2-3].
